verdict.rationale: Community evidence confirms GitLab's GitHub importer migrates repos, issues, PRs, wikis, milestones, labels and comments, described as straightforward, and docs cover self-hosted install methods (Linux package, Helm chart, Operator) enabling moves to cloud-native setups. But there is no explicit first-party documentation of dedicated user-account migration tooling or a comprehensive self-hosted-to-SaaS migration path, missing for 10: dedicated user-migration tooling docs, explicit self-hosted-to-cloud migration guide, independent corroboration beyond one community thread.
